WorldCover uses 11 land cover classes at 10m resolution. Class codes are standardised integers — do not reclassify without documenting. Attribution (CC BY 4.0) is mandatory in all map outputs and reports using this layer. Update cycle approximately 1-3 years — check for newer WorldCover epoch before any major system update. Resolution (10m) is finer than DEM (~90m or 30m) — be aware of resolution mismatch when combining with terrain derivatives.
